靈文 is the posthumous title Han Wendi gave his maternal grandfather, and 武、宣 are Emperors Wu and Xuan of Han; literal error: "Empress Dowager Bo" and "mothers" misidentify the honorees.

會稽王昱 is Sima Yu, Prince of Kuaiji; literal error: "Yu Yi" garbles the prince's name.
On that summer day in 274 Jin’s Empress Yang Yan passed—alas!
On the bingyin day of the seventh month, in autumn of the tenth Taishi year (274), Jin’s Empress Yang Yan passed—alas!
秋七月丙寅 is the bingyin day of the seventh month in autumn; literal error: "summer day" contradicts 秋 and drops the date.
Youxin wed Yin; Jiang water wed Zhou—inner chambers rang with virtue.
Youxin wed Yin; Jiang and Si married into Zhou—inner chambers rang with virtue.
姜姒 are the Zhou consorts Tai Jiang and Tai Si; literal error: "Jiang water" mistakes the names for a river.
Like Boyu of Zhou I ache—he wore bright robes to delight his kin.
Long ago Boyu, in tender devotion,—he wore bright robes to delight his kin.
昔伯瑜之婉孌兮 says "long ago Boyu, so devoted"; literal error: "of Zhou" is invented and "I ache" is not in the line.
Shaman Wu worked spells; healers He and Que brewed drafts.
Shaman Xian worked spells; healers He and Que brewed drafts.
巫咸 is Shaman Xian (咸 is his name); literal error: "Shaman Wu" renders 巫 (shaman) as a name.
Gentle primal queen—she truly spread kindness.
實宣慈焉 means she truly spread compassion; literal error: "widowed kindness" is a garbled rendering.
She shot back, “I fear death itself—why fear an emperor?”
She shot back, “I do not fear even death—why should I fear Your Majesty?”
死且不畏 means "I do not fear even death"; literal error: "I fear death itself" inverts the meaning.
She shot back, “You marched north against Gongsun and west against Zhuge—what else is warlord stock?”
She shot back, “Your house marched north against Gongsun and held off Zhuge in the west—what else is warlord stock?”
北伐公孫，西距諸葛 refers to the Sima house's campaigns (Sima Yi), not the emperor himself, and 距 is to resist; literal error: "You marched ... west against" misstates actor and action.
On xinmao in early 272 she became crown princess [7].
On the xinmao day of the second month of 272 she became crown princess [7].
泰始八年二月辛卯 names the second month; literal error: "early 272" drops the month.
Jia Mo saw danger—planned coup with Pei Yi—Wang Yan backed out.
Jia Mo saw danger—plotted with Pei Wei and Wang Yan to depose her—Wang Yan backed out.
裴頠 is Pei Wei and 王衍 was a co-plotter; literal error: "Pei Yi" misreads 頠 and Wang Yan's role is dropped.
Ill diviners forbade “Guangcheng”—she became Princess Yicheng.
Ill diviners forbade “Guangcheng”—her fief was changed to Yicheng.
改封宜城 means her enfeoffment was changed to Lady of Yicheng; literal error: "Princess" invents a title she did not hold.
The empress left the palace to tend her for over ten days; the heir often visited her Yicheng residence with physicians, scrupulously courteous.
后出侍疾 has the empress nursing her mother, and 太子常往宜城第 has the heir visiting; literal error: the English makes Minhuai nurse "her mother".
Jiong hated her mother—Lun used him.
The empress had a feud with Jiong’s mother, so Lun sent him.
后與冏母有隙 means the empress had a grudge with Jiong's mother; literal error: "Jiong hated her mother" reverses who was at odds with whom.
May Your Majesty consult further with the Grand Tutor in depth; do not let near and far grow doubtful and draw reproach from all under Heaven."
May Your Majesty consult further with the Grand Steward in depth; do not let near and far grow doubtful and draw reproach from all under Heaven."
太宰 is Grand Steward (Sima Yong); literal error: "Grand Tutor" mistranslates the office.
Liu Yao usurped the throne and made her empress.
僭位，以為皇后 means he usurped the throne and made her empress; literal error: "consort" understates 皇后 and the usurpation is dropped.
Wu sent her to tutor him in bed—she conceived.
Wu sent her to the Eastern Palace to attend him in bed—she conceived.
遣往東宮侍寢 means sent to serve in his bedchamber; literal error: "tutor" is not in the text.
